about_the_game:
A set of Mana Seeds, adventure bento boxes, and mascots. Bento boxes will remain empty after use, increasing the number of boxes you can carry. Mascots can be displayed anywhere onscreen.

Potato Pie Bento Box
Star of the Shield
Always Together: Lila Shell

*Potato Pie Bento Box and Star of the Shield can also be obtained in-game.
*Open [DLC] under [Items] in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After receiving items, place mascots via [Items] -> [Used Items] in the main menu.
*Please note that all items in excess of the maximum amount will be lost.
